blocks.text: A celebration rarely begins with the cake, but the cake often becomes the part everyone remembers. It is brought out after the meal, placed at the center of the table—and somehow, it keeps everyone lingering a little longer. Birthdays, family reunions, office milestones, and holiday gatherings all have their own rhythm, but cake gives them a shared ending. The new Goldilocks Signature Matcha brings a more modern flavor to that familiar tradition. Four layers of matcha sponge are soaked in a rich matcha milk sauce, with matcha whipped cream and plain whipped cream in between layers. It is then finished off […]...
